notes.title: Surgery Update!
notes.notes:
New Surgery Update!

Check out the brand new Reception Desk to see your world's hospital stats, register friends as doctors, and level up!

Once you meet specific requirements, Leveling up your hospital unlocks more beds, auto surgeons & more!

Place operating tables in your hospital which spawn in surg-e bots! These can also be used to perform surgery on other players!

The Auto Surgeon Station cures Maladies, Deposit tools and earn World Locks by curing other players!
